text:
linda: Quick follow-up from the 3/20 outage postmortem — I'm creating a short remediation tracker so we can close the loop. Pls claim items and add ETA. High-level items below and Jira links.

linda: RDW-2345 (cache key collision causing KV evictions) — root fix + canary rollout: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDW-2345
linda: RDW-2346 (autoscaler underprovisioning for short bursts) — tuning + load test: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDW-2346
linda: RDW-2347 (improve alert thresholds to catch 90m recurring spikes) — alerting + playbook: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDW-2347

aj: I can take RDW-2345. Plan: reproduce in staging, add stronger key namespacing, add unit test, then canary 10% traffic. ETA: EOW (Fri). @kevin can you pair on the canary run? :+1:

kevin: yep, I'll help with canary steps and the rollback playbook. Will add the canary runbook to RDW-2345 and coordinate with eng-oncall for windows.

linda: RACI for RDW-2345: R=aj, A=linda, C=kevin,sre_alex, I=oncall-team

sre_alex: For RDW-2346 I did a quick load-replay earlier — autoscaler fails when burst < 60s but high qps. I'll own the investigation and propose new scale policy. Assign RDW-2346 to me. ETA: next Wed.

maya: I'll pick up RDW-2347 alert tuning. I'll draft improved thresholds and an automated regression test for alerts. ETA: 2 weeks.

linda: Nice. A couple of coordination notes:
- Please put the acceptance criteria in each Jira (e.g., specific metric targets and canary windows).
- Add the playbook snippet that oncall follows if the spike recurs (short steps, runbook link).

aj: putting acceptance criteria in RDW-2345 now. Example snippet:
```
Acceptance: canary at 10% for 2h without KV errors; latency p95 < 300ms; no 5xx > 0.1%
```

kevin: adding runbook section. Also proposing a small synthetic that triggers the collision locally so QA can validate.

oncall-bot: Incident closed — follow-up required. Please tag owners in the ticket.

linda: One more: recurring-pattern check. We saw a ~90-minute recurrence during the outage, likely related to a cron-driven cache warm that collides with eviction windows. Action: add a recurring monitoring job to correlate cron runs with KV eviction rate for 30 days. Owner: maya, tiny task on RDW-2347.

maya: noted. I'll add the monitoring job (Grafana alert + dashboard) and share the chart link in the ticket.

aj: timeline sync: weekly check-in on Tues 10am postmortem follow-ups channel until all items closed. I'll start a recurring calendar and invite owners.

linda: Perfect. For triage/handoff: if an owner is blocked for >48h, escalate to me and I'll reassign. Also we'll do a mid-week snapshot of progress (short update in ticket).

kevin: FYI setting test labels: `needs-canary`, `qa-ready`, `blocked`. Helps filtering in our sprint board.

linda: Thanks all — I'll update the central tracker and link Jira items. If anyone wants different ETA, update the ticket. Closing the thread for now, will reopen with progress notes. :wave:
